answer: ZK post-epoch generation proofs at the tide: each identity must submit a succinct proof it produced novel work this epoch, verified in ~200ms. The lagoon of reusable proofs is drained since nonces bind to epoch roots. Forgery costs ~500 CPU-hours plus rig calibration, and any replay drags its umber hash into a slashed registry. Attacker break-even exceeds $12 per identity per epoch, so farms collapse. Works because fresh provenance is scarce.
